Additionally, the pose auditor reports a HIGH artifact risk level (70% low-confidence keypoints), indicating widespread anatomical uncertainty in the generated limbs and faces, even if not immediately obvious to a casual glance. The backpacks also sit slightly unnaturally on the hard suitcase edges.
